conventions.hamiltonian: H = w_a a^dag a + w_b b^dag b + A cos(w_p t) sin(phihat) [+ A_z cos(w_a t + theta) sin(phihat)], phihat = phi_a(a+a^dag) + phi_b(b+b^dag)
conventions.amplitudes: A = 2 E_J eps_p (pump, phi_Delta = pi/2, phi_Sigma = -pi/2 + eps_p cos w_p t, first order in eps_p); A_z = 2 E_J eps_z (readout flux tone)
conventions.E: E = exp(-Phi^2/2), Phi^2 = phi_a^2 + phi_b^2, kept exact (H1 ~ E, H2 ~ E^2)
conventions.frame: interaction picture of w_a a^dag a + w_b b^dag b; a^dag^p a^q b^dag^r b^s rotates as exp(i[(p-q)w_a + (r-s)w_b]t)
conventions.H_eff: H1 + H2 with H1 = zero-frequency part of V_I(t) (RWA), H2 = sum_{nu != 0} V(nu)V(-nu)/nu (van Vleck / time-averaging, second order); checked on the beam-splitter AC Stark shift (a-like level shifts by +g^2/(w_a - w_b))
conventions.operator_basis: all coefficients multiply normal-ordered monomials; H_eff = Delta_a a^dag a + Delta_b b^dag b + (K_a/2) a^dag^2 a^2 + (K_b/2) b^dag^2 b^2 + chi_ab a^dag a b^dag b + [g2 a^2 b^dag + g2_na a^dag a^3 b^dag + g2_nb a^2 b^dag^2 b + c_a4b2 a^4 b^dag^2 + h.c.] + c_number
conventions.frequencies: 'formula' keeps w_a, w_b, w_p independent (valid for a detuned pump; tone w_z = w_a folded into w_a); 'formula_reduced_wp_eq_2wa_minus_wb' substitutes w_p = 2 w_a - w_b (exact cancellations, leading order decided there). Zero frequency decided at w_a : w_b : w_p = 5 : 6 : 4. Pairs with nu1 + nu2 = 0 only through the resonance condition use the Hermitian form (1/2) V(nu1) V(nu2) [1/nu1 - 1/nu2]
conventions.phi_degree: total power of phi_a and phi_b in the polynomial prefactor (E excluded); H1 exact to degree D, H2 exact to degree D+1
conventions.disp_vs_quantum: disp_part = pairs with at least one linear factor (a, a^dag, b, b^dag) in V(nu)V(-nu): the classical pump-displacement contribution; quantum_part = nonlinear x nonlinear
conventions.sign_of_g2: g2 (coefficient of a^2 b^dag) is negative in this convention: -(1/2) E_J eps_p phi_a^2 phi_b E; |g2| matches the prompt formula times E
conventions.tone_terms: readout entries are divided by eps_Z^k with eps_Z = (A_z/2) phi_a E e^{-i theta} the first-order coefficient of a^dag; theta = 0 numerically; k = tone power. Phase law: a^dag, a^dag^2 a, a^dag b^dag b, a b^dag, a^dag^3 b ~ e^{-i theta}; a^dag^2 ~ e^{-2 i theta}; Stark/Kerr ~ |eps_Z|^2

first_order_notes: H1 (pump only) contains no number-conserving term (no Stark shift, Kerr, chi, c-number): every term carries exp(+-i w_p t), and a monomial is resonant only if 5 dn_a + 6 dn_b = -+4 with dn = p - q, r - s. Solutions are (dn_a, dn_b) = (-2 + 6k, 1 - 5k); sin is odd so p+q+r+s is odd, which forces dn_a + dn_b = k - 1 odd, i.e. k even. k = 0 gives a^2 b^dag and its number dressings; k = +-2 needs degree >= 19. So a^dag^4 b^4 (k=1, degree 8) is excluded by parity. With the tone (np = 0, nz = +-1) the resonant monomials are a^dag dressings only (dn_a, dn_b) = (+-1, 0).

g2_na.operator: a^dag a^3 b^dag (= a^dag a . a^2 b^dag)

g2_nb.operator: a^2 b^dag^2 b (= a^2 b^dag . b^dag b)

eps_Z_nb.formula: -1/2 * A_z phi_a phi_b^2 E e^{-1i theta}
eps_Z_nb.formula_reduced_wp_eq_2wa_minus_wb: -1/2 * A_z phi_a phi_b^2 E e^{-1i theta}

tt_adag2.formula: (1/8/(- w_a + w_b) + 1/8/(w_a + w_b)) * A_z^2 phi_a^2 phi_b^2 E^2 e^{-2i theta} + 1/8/(2 w_a) * A_z^2 phi_a^4 E^2 e^{-2i theta}
tt_adag2.formula_next_order: -1/8/(2 w_b) * A_z^2 phi_a^2 phi_b^4 E^2 e^{-2i theta} + -1/4/(w_a + w_b) * A_z^2 phi_a^4 phi_b^2 E^2 e^{-2i theta} + -1/8/(2 w_a) * A_z^2 phi_a^6 E^2 e^{-2i theta}
tt_adag2.formula_reduced_wp_eq_2wa_minus_wb: (1/8/(- w_a + w_b) + 1/8/(w_a + w_b)) * A_z^2 phi_a^2 phi_b^2 E^2 e^{-2i theta} + 1/8/(2 w_a) * A_z^2 phi_a^4 E^2 e^{-2i theta}

disp_part.formula_leading: (1/8/(- w_a + w_b) + 1/8/(w_a + w_b)) * A_z^2 phi_a^2 phi_b^2 E^2 e^{-2i theta} + 1/8/(2 w_a) * A_z^2 phi_a^4 E^2 e^{-2i theta}
disp_part.formula_leading_reduced: (1/8/(- w_a + w_b) + 1/8/(w_a + w_b)) * A_z^2 phi_a^2 phi_b^2 E^2 e^{-2i theta} + 1/8/(2 w_a) * A_z^2 phi_a^4 E^2 e^{-2i theta}

tt_chi_ab.operator: a^dag a b^dag b (tone x tone)

fock_crosscheck_all_orders.method: H2 = sum V(nu)V(-nu)/nu from exact matrix sin(phihat), N_a = N_b = 14; pump-only for pump terms, tone on for pt_a_bdag
